title: Coherent terms of a finite-projective total tensor
statement: Let X be a locally Noetherian scheme [def-pc-scheme] [pqf-def-locnoeth]. Let P and N be cochain complexes of O_X-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Suppose P^n is zero outside a fixed integer interval [a,b], and for every n there are maps P^n to O_X^m and O_X^m to P^n whose composite on P^n is the identity, for some finite rank m. Suppose every term of N is coherent [pqf-def-coherent], without any boundedness assumption on N. Then every term of the signed direct-sum total complex Tot(P tensor N) [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product] [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves] is coherent.

source.place: perfect.tex, label lemma-tensor-perfect (0DJQ), displayed finite sum in its proof; coherent.tex, label lemma-coherent-abelian-Noetherian (01Y0)

proof.text: In total degree i the coproduct summands are P^p tensor N^q for p+q=i. By the [a,b] bounds of P, all summands with p outside this finite integer interval are zero, since tensorRight preserves zero objects. Delete these summands by the coproduct universal property. For each of the remaining finitely many p there is exactly one q=i-p.

Tensor the given finite-free retraction of P^p with N^q. Tensor preserves the splitting equation. Distribution over finite coproducts, the tensor-unit isomorphism and the definition of the free module identify the ambient tensor with a finite direct sum of N^q. This finite sum is coherent. Its retract is coherent: the splitting identifies the retract with the kernel of identity minus the split idempotent on the ambient coherent module. Kernel closure and isomorphism invariance therefore give coherence of each summand.

The surviving sum is finite, so finite-sum closure and isomorphism invariance imply that the total degree-i term is coherent. If a>b every summand is zero and the total is zero, hence coherent. Empty schemes and zero ranks are included. No bound on N is needed because the fixed equation p+q=i already determines q.

theorem finiteRetract_tensorComplex_coherent_terms
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    (P N : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
    (a b : ℤ)
    (hPbounds : ∀ n : ℤ, n < a ∨ b < n → IsZero (P.X n))
    (hPfree : ∀ n : ℤ, ∃ m : ℕ,
      ∃ (ι : P.X n ⟶ SheafOfModules.free
          (R := moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) (ULift.{u} (Fin m)))
        (π : SheafOfModules.free
          (R := moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) (ULift.{u} (Fin m)) ⟶ P.X n),
        ι ≫ π = 𝟙 (P.X n))
    (hNcoherent : ∀ n : ℤ, RingedSpace.IsCoherent X.toRingedSpace (N.X n)) :
    ∀ i : ℤ, RingedSpace.IsCoherent X.toRingedSpace
        ((CochainComplex.mapBifunctor P N (curriedTensor _)).X i)
